                            return Default

                function t19.SelectTab(p153, p154)
                    if p154 == p153.ActiveTab then
                        return
                    end

                    local ActiveTab = p153.ActiveTab

                    p153.ActiveTab = p154

                    if ActiveTab then
                        ActiveTab.Page.Visible = false
                        ActiveTab._paintNav(false, false)
                    end

                    p154.Page.Visible = p153 == p153.Window.ActiveCategory
                    p154._paintNav(true, false)
                end

                function t20._disconnectAll(p157)
                    for _, v in ipairs(p157._connections) do
                        pcall(function()
                            v:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end

                    table.clear(p157._connections)
                end
                function t20._viewportSize(_)
                    local CurrentCamera = Workspace2.CurrentCamera
                    local v583 = CurrentCamera and CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
                    local ok, result, v586 = pcall(function()
                        return GuiService:GetGuiInset()
                    end)

                    if ok then
                        v583 = Vector2.new(math.max(1, v583.X - result.X - v586.X), math.max(1, v583.Y - result.Y - v586.Y))
                    end

                    return v583
                end
                function t20._updateResponsiveScale(p159, p160)
                    if not p159.RootScale or not p159.DefaultSize then
                        return
                    end

                    local n2 = 1

                    if p159.Responsive then
                        local v590 = p159:_viewportSize()
                        local v591 = p159.ResponsiveMargin or 12
                        local v592 = math.max(1, v590.X - v591 * 2)
                        local v593 = math.max(1, v590.Y - v591 * 2)
                        local v594 = math.min(1, v592 / p159.DefaultSize.X, v593 / p159.DefaultSize.Y)

                        n2 = math.max(0.1, v594)
                    end

                    p159.ResponsiveScale = n2
                    p159.RootScale.Scale = n2

                    if p160 then
                        p159.Root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                    end
                end
                function t20.SelectCategory(p161, p162)
                    local v597 = type(p162) == "string" and p161.CategoriesByName[p162] or p162

                    if not v597 or v597 == p161.ActiveCategory then
                        return
                    end

                    local ActiveCategory = p161.ActiveCategory

                    p161.ActiveCategory = v597

                    if ActiveCategory then
                        ActiveCategory._paintChip(false)
                        ActiveCategory.NavFrame.Visible = false

                        local v599 = ActiveCategory.ActiveTab and ActiveCategory.ActiveTab.Page

                        if v599 then
                            v599.Visible = false
                        end
                    end

                    v597.NavFrame.Visible = true
                    v597._paintChip(true)

                    if v597.ActiveTab then
                        v597.ActiveTab.Page.Visible = true
                    end
                end

            function t20.SetUser(p181, p182)
                local v649 = p182 or {}
                local Name = v649.Name

                if Name == nil or tostring(Name) == "" then
                    Name = LocalPlayer2 and (LocalPlayer2.DisplayName or LocalPlayer2.Name) or "User"
                end

                local Role = v649.Role

                if Role == nil or tostring(Role) == "" then
                    Role = "Cliente Oi"
                end

                local v652 = typeof(v649.RoleColor) == "Color3" and v649.RoleColor or p181.Theme.Cyan
                local v653 = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(v652.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(v652.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(v652.B * 255 + 0.5))
                local v654 = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(p181.Theme.Text.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(p181.Theme.Text.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(p181.Theme.Text.B * 255 + 0.5))
                local v655 = tostring(Name):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")
                local v656 = tostring(Role):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")

                p181.UserName.RichText = true
                p181.UserName.TextColor3 = p181.Theme.TextMuted
                p181.UserName.Text = string.format("Username: <font color=\"%s\">%s</font>", v654, v655)
                p181.UserRole.RichText = true
                p181.UserRole.TextColor3 = p181.Theme.TextMuted
                p181.UserRole.Text = string.format("Role: <font color=\"%s\">%s</font>", v653, v656)

                if type(v649.Avatar) == "string" and v649.Avatar ~= "" then
                    p181.UserAvatar.Image = v649.Avatar

                    return
                end

                if v649.UserId or LocalPlayer2 and LocalPlayer2.UserId then
                    local v657 = tonumber(v649.UserId) or LocalPlayer2.UserId
                    local ok, result = pcall(function()
                        return Players2:GetUserThumbnailAsync(v657, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
                    end)

                    if ok and result then
                        p181.UserAvatar.Image = result
                    end
                end
            end
            function t20.SetVisible(p183, p184)
                if p183._destroyed then
                    return
                end

                local v662 = p184 == true

                p183._targetVisible = v662
                p183._visibilityToken = (p183._visibilityToken or 0) + 1

                local _visibilityToken = p183._visibilityToken

                if p183._visibilityTween then
                    p183._visibilityTween:Cancel()
                end

                if p183._visibilityConnection then
                    p183._visibilityConnection:Disconnect()
                    p183._visibilityConnection = nil
                end

                if v662 then
                    p183.Root.Visible = true
                end

                p183._visibilityTween = TweenService2:Create(p183.Root, tweenInfo3, {
					GroupTransparency = not v662 and 1 or 0
				})

                if p183.RootStroke then
                    v25(p183.RootStroke, tweenInfo3, {
						Transparency = v662 and p183.RootStrokeBase or 1
					})
                end

                if p183.RootShadow and p183.ShadowProp then
                    v25(p183.RootShadow, tweenInfo3, {
						[p183.ShadowProp] = v662 and p183.ShadowBase or 1
					})
                end

                if not v662 then
                    p183._visibilityConnection = p183._visibilityTween.Completed:Connect(function(p185)
                        if p185 == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and (p183._visibilityToken == _visibilityToken and not p183._targetVisible) then
                            p183.Root.Visible = false
                        end

                        if p183._visibilityToken == _visibilityToken then
                            p183._visibilityConnection = nil
                        end
                    end)
                end

                p183._visibilityTween:Play()
            end
            function t20.Toggle(p186)
                p186:SetVisible(not p186._targetVisible)
            end
            function t20.Notify(p187, p188)
                local v667 = p188 or {}

                if type(v667) == "string" then
                    v667 = {
						Title = v667
					}
                end

                local Theme = p187.Theme
                local v669 = tonumber(v667.Duration) or 4
                local str = tostring(v667.Title or "Notificacao")
                local v671 = v667.Text and tostring(v667.Text) or nil
                local v672 = v20("Frame", {
					Name = "Toast",
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, not v671 and 38 or 56),
					BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ClipsDescendants = true
				}, p187.ToastHost)

                v21(v672, 6)

                local v673 = v22(v672, Theme.Border, 1, 1)
                local v674 = v20("Frame", {
					Name = "Accent",
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -16),
					BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0
				}, v672)

                v21(v674, 999)

                local v675 = v20("Frame", {
					Name = "Inner",
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0
				}, v672)
                local t22 = {}

                t22[#t22 + 1] = v20("TextLabel", {
					Name = "Title",
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, not v671 and 0 or 10),
					Size = v671 and UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 16) or UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, 0),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Text = str,
					TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
					TextTransparency = 1,
					TextSize = 14,
					FontFace = font3,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
					TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
				}, v675)

                if v671 then
                    t22[#t22 + 1] = v20("TextLabel", {
						Name = "Body",
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 28),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 18),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Text = v671,
						TextColor3 = Theme.TextMuted,
						TextTransparency = 1,
						TextSize = 13,
						FontFace = font2,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
						TextWrapped = true
					}, v675)
                end

                v25(v672, tweenInfo2, {
					BackgroundTransparency = 0
				})
                v25(v674, tweenInfo2, {
					BackgroundTransparency = 0
				})
                v25(v673, tweenInfo2, {
					Transparency = 0.4
				})

                for _, v in ipairs(t22) do
                    v25(v, tweenInfo2, {
						TextTransparency = 0
					})
                end

                local function v679()
                    if not v672.Parent then
                        return
                    end

                    v25(v672, tweenInfo, {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1
					})
                    v25(v674, tweenInfo, {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1
					})
                    v25(v673, tweenInfo, {
						Transparency = 1
					})

                    for _, v in ipairs(t22) do
                        v25(v, tweenInfo, {
							TextTransparency = 1
						})
                    end

                    task.delay(0.2, function()
                        if v672 and v672.Parent then
                            v672:Destroy()
                        end
                    end)
                end

                task.delay(v669, v679)

                return {
					Instance = v672,
					Dismiss = v679
				}
            end
            function t20.Destroy(p189)
                if p189._destroyed then
                    return
                end

                p189._destroyed = true

                if p189._visibilityTween then
                    p189._visibilityTween:Cancel()
                end

                if p189._visibilityConnection then
                    p189._visibilityConnection:Disconnect()
                end

                p189:_disconnectAll()

                if p189.ScreenGui and p189.ScreenGui.Parent then
                    p189.ScreenGui:Destroy()
                end

                for i, v in ipairs(t1.Windows) do
                    if v == p189 then
                        table.remove(t1.Windows, i)

                        return
                    end
                end
            end

                    if not u693 then
                        return

                        return

                        u694 = true

                end))

                    if not u693 then
                        return

                        return
                    end

                    u695 = nil

						Scale = not u692 and 1 or 1.05
					})
                end))

					})

                        return

					})

            local t23 = {}
            t23.__index = t23
            function t23._track(p194, p195)
                table.insert(p194._connections, p195)

                return p195
            end
            function t23._viewportSize(p196)
                return t20._viewportSize(p196)

            function t23._updateResponsiveScale(p197, p198)
                if not p197.RootScale or not p197.DefaultSize then
                    return
                end

                local n3 = 1

                if p197.Responsive then
                    local v741 = p197:_viewportSize()
                    local v742 = p197.ResponsiveMargin or 12
                    local v743 = math.min(1, math.max(1, v741.X - v742 * 2) / p197.DefaultSize.X, math.max(1, v741.Y - v742 * 2) / p197.DefaultSize.Y)

                    n3 = math.max(0.1, v743)
                end

                p197.ResponsiveScale = n3
                p197.RootScale.Scale = n3

                if p198 then
                    p197.Root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                end
            end
            function t23.Close(p199)
                if p199._closed then
                    return
                end

                p199._closed = true

                if p199.RootStroke then
                    v25(p199.RootStroke, tweenInfo3, {
						Transparency = 1
					})
                end

                if p199.RootShadow and p199.ShadowProp then
                    v25(p199.RootShadow, tweenInfo3, {
						[p199.ShadowProp] = 1
					})
                end

                local tween = TweenService2:Create(p199.Root, tweenInfo3, {
					GroupTransparency = 1
				})

                tween.Completed:Connect(function()
                    for _, v in ipairs(p199._connections) do
                        pcall(function()
                            v:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end

                    if p199.ScreenGui and p199.ScreenGui.Parent then
                        p199.ScreenGui:Destroy()
                    end
                end)
                tween:Play()
            end
            function t1.CreateLoader(p200, p201)
                local u748 = p201 or {}

                if v758 then

                end

                local v759 = v20("ScreenGui", {

                local function v794(p215)
                    if p215.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p215.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        v766._dragging = true
                        v766._dragStart = p215.Position
                        v766._dragOrigin = v760.AbsolutePosition
                    end
                end

                v766:_track(v760.InputBegan:Connect(v794))
                v766:_track(v771.InputBegan:Connect(v794))
                v766:_track(UserInputService2.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if not v766._dragging then
                        return
                    end

                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        return
                    end

                    local v1774 = input.Position - v766._dragStart
                    local v1775 = v766:_viewportSize()
                    local AbsoluteSize = v760.AbsoluteSize
                    local v1777 = v766.ResponsiveMargin or 8
                    local v1778 = v1775.X - AbsoluteSize.X - v1777
                    local v1779 = v1775.Y - AbsoluteSize.Y - v1777
                    local v1780 = v1777 <= v1778 and math.clamp(v766._dragOrigin.X + v1774.X, v1777, v1778) or math.max(0, (v1775.X - AbsoluteSize.X) / 2)
                    local v1781 = v1777 <= v1779 and math.clamp(v766._dragOrigin.Y + v1774.Y, v1777, v1779) or math.max(0, (v1775.Y - AbsoluteSize.Y) / 2)

                    v760.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v1780 + AbsoluteSize.X / 2, v1781 + AbsoluteSize.Y / 2)
                end))
                v766:_track(UserInputService2.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        v766._dragging = false
                    end
                end))

                return v766
            end

    local function v149(p268, p269, p270, p271)

    local function v150(p272, p273, p274, p275)

        p272.character = p273
        p272.humanoid = p274
        p272.root = p275

                table.insert(p272.bodyParts, child)
            end

        local v1060 = p274.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 and t37 or t38

        for _, v in ipairs(v1060) do

				p273:FindFirstChild(v[1]),

    local function v151(p276)
        return p276 ~= nil and (p276.MaxHealth > 0 and p276.Health > p276.MaxHealth)
    end

    function v152(p277)
        if p277 >= 1000000000 then
            return string.format("%.1fB", p277 / 1000000000)
        end

        if p277 >= 1000000 then
            return string.format("%.1fM", p277 / 1000000)
        end

        if p277 >= 1000 then
            return string.format("%.0fk", p277 / 1000)
        end

        return string.format("%d", p277)
    end
    function t24.godModePlayers()
        local t41 = {}

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                local Character = player.Character
                local v1069 = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                if v151(v1069) then
                    t41[#t41 + 1] = {
						player = player,
						health = v1069.Health
					}
                end
            end
        end

        table.sort(t41, function(p278, p279)
            return p278.health > p279.health
        end)

        return t41
    end

    local function v156(p284, p285, p286, p287, p288)
        local Character = p284.Character
        local v1091 = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local v1092 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not Character or (not v1091 or v1091.Health <= 0 or not v1092) then
            p285.character = nil
            p285.nextVisualUpdate = p288 + 0.05
            v141(p285)

            return
        end

        v150(p285, Character, v1091, v1092)

        local Magnitude = (v1092.Position - p287).Magnitude

        if Magnitude > t25.maxDistance then
            p285.nextVisualUpdate = p288 + 0.05
            v141(p285)

            return
        end

        v155(p284, p285)

        if t25.highlight then
            local v1094 = v148(p285, Character)

            if v1094 then
                v1094.Enabled = true
            end
        elseif p285.highlight then
            p285.highlight.Enabled = false
        end

local function v192()
    if not t25.bestWeaponEnabled or t24.destroyed then
        return
    end

    local v1315, v1316 = v189()

    if not v1315 or v190(v1315) then
        return
    end

    local elapsed = os.clock()

    if v1315 == t24.bestWeaponLastName and elapsed - t24.bestWeaponLastAttempt < 2 then
        return
    end

    t24.bestWeaponLastName = v1315
    t24.bestWeaponLastAttempt = elapsed

    local OrpheusShared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("OrpheusShared")
    local v1319 = OrpheusShared and OrpheusShared:FindFirstChild("InvRemotes")
    local v1320 = v1319 and v1319:FindFirstChild("InvRequest")

    if not v1320 or not v1320:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
        return
    end

    local v1321 = v191()
    local InvVals = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("InvVals")
    local v1323 = InvVals and InvVals:FindFirstChild("SlotsAtivos")

    if (v1323 and tonumber(v1323.Value) or 3) <= #v1321 then
        local u1324
        local huge = math.huge
        for _, v in ipairs(v1321) do
            if v1315 ~= v.Name then
                local v1328 = v186(v.Name) or -1

                if v1328 < huge then
                    u1324 = v
                    huge = v1328
                end
            end
        end
        if u1324 and huge < v1316 then
            pcall(function()
                v1320:InvokeServer("desequipainv", u1324)
            end)
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
    end

    if not v190(v1315) then
        pcall(function()
            v1320:InvokeServer("semespacoinv", v1315)
        end)
    end
end

    end)

local function v221()
    local OrpheusShared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("OrpheusShared")
    local v1377 = OrpheusShared and OrpheusShared:FindFirstChild("Concessionaria")
    local v1378 = v1377 and v1377:FindFirstChild("Veiculos")

    if not v1378 then
        t53.catalogo = {}

        return
    end

    local t54 = {}

    for _, child in ipairs(v1378:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Model") then
            local v1382 = v220(child)

            if v1382 and v1382.valor > 0 and v1382.valor < 1E+50 then
                table.insert(t54, v1382)
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(t54, function(p321, p322)
        if p321.valor == p322.valor then
            return p321.nome < p322.nome
        end

        return p321.valor > p322.valor
    end)
    t53.catalogo = {}

    for i = 1, math.min(10, #t54) do
        local v1384 = t54[i]

        t53.catalogo[v1384.nome] = v1384
    end

    for i = 2, #t54 do
        assert(t54[i - 1].valor >= t54[i].valor, "ranking de carros fora de ordem")
    end
end

        local v2278 = v72()

        if v2278 then
            v86(v2278, false)
            v2278:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
        end

        local v2279 = v85()

        if v2279 then
            v2279.Disabled = false
        end
    end)

    for _, v in ipairs(t24.connections) do
        pcall(function()
            v:Disconnect()
        end)
    end

    t24.connections = {}

    for k, v in pairs(t25.bundles) do
        v142(v)
        t25.bundles[k] = nil
    end

    pcall(function()
        local v2280 = v72()

        if v2280 then
            local v2281 = v73()

            if v2281 then
                v2280:MoveTo(v2281.Position)
            end

            v2280.WalkSpeed = 16
            v2280.JumpPower = 50
        end
    end)
end
return true
